capabilities: Insert dates from a trigger-opened calendar
Select quick dates with letter shortcuts
Define custom dates with Moment formulas
Cycle date formats in the picker
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese documentation and UI; works offline and stores settings in the current vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pick and insert today, relative, or custom-formatted dates at the cursor without leaving the editor.
summary: Date insertion plugin that opens a keyboard-navigable calendar and quick-date shortcuts from a trigger character in the Markdown editor.
